scope: Reduce otherwise approved AND baseline-affordable adds only. No timer/exit/pulse/zone/size-up policy. Fractions apply to the original count-based requested size, not recursively to the prior executed rung. Cost caps use surviving entry-cost notional, not mark value or margin. They are fresh 10-rung cost plus zero or half the standard 11th rung. If cap room is less than one base rung ($800), skip that add; otherwise clip. No forced deleveraging or top-ups within the same slot.
auditGate: Before variants, compare exact full-selected-fill inventory allocation against the production allocator, verify count-based calcAddSize and preserve transactional lastAddTime. Reproduce all four prior digests using explicit legacy_reanchor clock, then rerun corrected-clock baselines. A legacy baseline does not certify the transactional clock.
parityRepair: Old replay used closePositionsByIndices semantics after S/R partials. Live applyObservedPartialFill/finalizePartialClose preserve lastAddTime while inventory remains. Current replay default changes ONLY that clock. Legacy clock is explicitly archival.
screens: Reuse the baseSpec screens without retuning. Intervention samples count distinct episodes with a size reduction or skipped add. Report all risk/profit trade-offs even when thresholds fail.
limits: Previously mined overlapping history; no live exact funding, maker/native queue, fill fragmentation, lot rounding, outages, liquidation or shared-account certification. Partial allocation audit assumes complete fills of planned selected IDs. Known rounding residuals can leave an additional live rung and must not be claimed modeled.
executionStress: Primary comparison uses both archived TP assumptions with next-open market actions and 0.055% each side. Additionally report a fixed-path 5bps adverse cost per side per executed notional, explicitly NOT a resimulated slippage path or funding ledger. No promotion while execution assumptions materially reverse conclusions.
